text:
sanjay: Heads-up we got a projected 35% Q3 production load increase for recommendation pipelines — starts July. Need to plan GPU reservations across regions. Anyone free?

elaine: will this be bursty? where's the traffic coming from?

sanjay: Mostly US+EMEA, but APAC spiky evenings. Estimates: +120k GPU hours/month on our mix. Breakdown: 60% throughput-sensitive (latency SLO), 30% batch, 10% embeddings.

kevin: can we cover with autoscaling on Dedicated? H200 lead time ~12w, H100 ~6w, L40S spot pools available but network egress concerns in eu-west.

maria: procurement: H200 price is ~1.6x H100 on quotes. Lead times from H100 vendor = 5-7 weeks if we commit today; H200 = 10-14 weeks. L40S available immediate but fewer units.

sanjay: propose reserve 200 H100 in us-west + 80 H200 in eu-west for floor capacity, and put autoscale to pull L40S as burst. That covers baseline + 20% slack. Thoughts?

elaine: math check? show numbers.

kevin: quick calc: each H100 yields ~12k hours/mo per unit (24/7), so 200 *12k = 2.4M GPU hours — seems huge. Wait our units smaller: we use per-GPU hours with utilization 60% -> effective = 7.2k hours/unit. So 200 -> 1.44M effective GPU-hours. We only need 120k. Maybe units count off.

maria: yeah we should be planning nodes not hours. Proposed commit: 30 H100 nodes (48GB?) in us-west, 12 H200 in eu-west, reserve 50 L40S burst pool via partners. Send PO triggers.

sanjay: ok updated plan: 30 H100 us-west, 12 H200 eu-west, 50 L40S burst. Expected coverage: steady throughput + 35% buffer. Cost delta +$120k/month. Can procurement get firm quotes + lead times?

procurement: noted. We'll push for 5-7 week expedited for H100; H200 vendor wants 12 weeks. Sending RFQ today. Also checking local stock in APAC partners.

infra-bot: Reservation request submitted: PO# 2025-445. ETA H100 us-west 2025-06-10 (est), H200 eu-west 2025-08-05 (est).

kevin: network concern: L40S partners in eu-west have egress caps. If we route heavy embeddings we hit charges. Suggest enabling rate-limited cross-region fallback and compress KV caches.

elaine: also can we shift some training/offline batch to off-peak to reduce peak? That saves ~15% peak GPU hours.

sanjay: action items: procurement: firm quotes + expedite; infra: add autoscale policy + fallback; cost: update forecast model with new reservation and egress assumptions. I'll follow up in 48h with updated projection.

maria: ack

kevin: autoscale snippet:
```
policy:
  min: 5
  max: 60
  scale_by: gpu_util
  cooldown: 300s
```

elaine: tagging @oncall for networking checks

procurement: adding vendor contact: nvidia-sales@example.com, partner rep: acme-cloud.

sanjay: thanks all :thumbsup:
